title: La Dolce Vita
scope: Nuevo dibujo desde el PDF. Las transcripciones y la paginación del pasaje coinciden con la edición previa.

pages.summary: Hermione recibe a Arianna mientras Blaise y Daphne compiten por el mejor clavado. La gran salpicadura de Blaise contrasta con la entrada limpia de Daphne.

panels.scene: Handover on low smooth rock. Daphne at left is only passing her daughter to Hermione. Hermione in center olive suit with chestnut curly updo securely cradles Arianna against her chest while Daphne keeps a gentle steadying hand on little girl's torso until transfer. Arianna golden-blonde wet wisps, blue eyes, turquoise baby one-piece. Pansy with dark chin-length bob on right sits holding Robin, chestnut curls and yellow-duck shorts. One of each child, exactly three adults, no one else necessary here. Different camera angle from the previous page.

Blaise, dark skin, short tight black curls, navy shorts and uncovered head, has climbed the short wooden rope gangway and pauses to address his group from the higher edge while facing them. Deck and visible wooden boards connect. One complete readable balloon of both sentences with tail facing Blaise.
dialogue: Blaise: Espero que todos estén prestando atención. No pienso repetirlo.

panels.scene: Pale Draco with platinum hair in the water by the low rock, face up toward Blaise and laughing. His one speech balloon contains the whole sentence. No other person in close-up.
dialogue: Draco: Podrías hacerlo bien la primera vez.

panels.scene: Blaise alone makes a broad expressive rotating dive from the high end of the original solid yacht gangway into open water away from rocks. One natural figure tipping diagonally into blue. Two arms stretch forward and separately connect at shoulders, legs together, cream rope rail well behind him. Tall splash just beyond his dive path.

The splash reaches the rock. Hermione supports Arianna securely with one arm around middle and raises one open hand above Arianna as a shield to droplets. Arianna smiles. Pansy sits right holding Robin securely at the waist, his own two arms raised playfully, Robin blue duck shorts. Clear connections along all forearms. Dress colors as in references.

Blaise resurfaces chest deep, looks to Daphne, who is standing securely on the dry low rock by the start of the gangway, laughing but remaining dry above the waist. One Blaise bubble and consistent navy shorts underwater. Daphne long wet blonde hair loose and opaque turquoise one-piece. Other family members out of frame but their holding positions unchanged.
dialogue: Blaise: Puedes retirarte si prefieres conservar la dignidad.

panels.scene: On the low rock and bridge, blonde Daphne in turquoise hands her single small cup from her natural arm to dark-haired Astoria at right, in terracotta suit and patterned ocher scarf. Astoria supports platinum Scorpius in gray shorts on her lap with her other arm, cup away from him. One speech balloon with tail to Daphne, the blonde adult. Daphne is just beginning to climb the same gangway from the dry stone.
dialogue: Daphne: No me preocupa competir contigo.

panels.scene: One graceful Daphne with loose long blonde hair following the arc, opaque turquoise one-piece, rotates off upper gangway toward open water far from rocks; arms forward, actual two legs. Already past the top of the pivot, close to entry with only a tiny white line of foam, smaller than Blaise's. Ordinary wide side view clearly separating the hull, water and swimmer.

On low rock Hermione holds turquoise Arianna and raises one of her little hands. Pansy sits with Robin securely supported by her legs as she applauds. Draco next to them applauds and Astoria in scarf, sitting near the bridge, holds platinum Scorpius supportively while smiling with them. Exactly three different babies and four adults. Recognizable hair, swimsuit colours, no extra fingers. Hermione's only sapphire at neck and any ring only LEFT ring finger. Pansy's thin bracelet only LEFT wrist and bare fingers.

Daphne having surfaced near Blaise. He steadies her by the side of the waist with his own clearly attached arm while she wipes water from her cheek with her own hand. Warm affectionate casual chest-up swim framing. Hair short tight black coils on Blaise, damp blonde strands on Daphne. No extra hands or added bubbles.

pages.review: Cotejado con PDF636. Cuatro turnos íntegros, orientación de los globos y concurso con dos entradas al agua de distinta salpicadura. Hermione recibe a Arianna y Pansy sigue con Robin. Astoria sostiene a Scorpius y recibe la copa. Cabello corto de Blaise, joyas y tres diseños infantiles conservados.
